name: Universell
author: Universell

sections.description:
The plugin connects your WordPress site with the Universell platform, allowing you to easily sync product, customer, and order data between the two. Once the plugin is installed and the connection is established, any products added to Universell will automatically be synced to your WordPress site. Similarly, any updates made in Universell will be reflected on WordPress, ensuring your site stays up-to-date with the latest information. The synchronization process keeps both systems aligned without the need for manual updates.

Arbitrary section

  1. Universell offers advanced features that are not available in WooCommerce.
  2. Known issues or limitations: No known issues at the moment. Compatibility with older WordPress versions (below 5.0) is not supported.

3rd Party / External service Documentation

This plugin is a product of universell.us and uses the API of universell.mybmr.com, also developed by universell.us.

The API is responsible for syncing inventory, customer, and order data between the Universell platform and your WordPress WooCommerce site in both directions. This ensures that your e-commerce data remains consistent and up-to-date across systems.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via the WordPress plugin dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. You will see the Universell menu in the left sidebar of the WordPress dashboard.
sections.faq:
Q: What the service is and what it is used for?

A: The API is used to connect the WordPress-WooCommerce site with the Universell platform at universell.mybmr.com, allowing automatic syncing of products, customers, and orders.

Q: What data is sent and when?

A: Inventory, customer, and order data are synced automatically in both directions between Universell and WordPress whenever changes occur.

Q: How do I use this plugin?

A: After installation, go to the Universell menu in the WordPress dashboard, enter your Universell credentials to establish the connection, and the plugin will automatically sync your products, customers, and orders.

Q: Can I customize the plugin?

A: Yes, you can customize the plugin by extending existing hooks and filters provided by WordPress. For more advanced customizations, refer to the plugin documentation.

Q: Is there a way to sync only specific data (e.g., only products)?

A: Currently, the plugin syncs all data (products, customers, and orders). Future updates may allow more granular control over what data gets synced.

Q: What data does the plugin sync between WordPress and Universell?

A: The plugin syncs three main types of data: products, customers, and orders. Any changes made in Universell will be reflected on your WordPress site, ensuring both platforms remain in sync.

Q: Do I need to manually update the data after the initial sync?

A: No, once the plugin is set up and connected to Universell, all data syncs automatically. You do not need to manually update products, customers, or orders after the initial sync.

Q: How do I establish a connection between WordPress and Universell?

A: To establish the connection, go to the Universell menu in the WordPress dashboard, enter your Universell credentials, and the plugin will handle the rest, syncing your data automatically.

Q: Can I disable the automatic syncing of certain data?

A: Currently, the plugin syncs all data types (products, customers, and orders). Future updates may include options to disable or selectively sync specific data types.

Q: Is the plugin compatible with other WordPress plugins or themes?

A: The plugin is designed to work with most standard WordPress themes and plugins. However, for optimal performance, we recommend using it with updated themes and plugins compatible with the latest WordPress versions.

Q: What happens if there’s an issue with the sync?

A: If there’s an issue during the sync, the plugin will attempt to re-sync the data. You can also manually trigger a sync from the Universell menu in your WordPress dashboard. If the issue persists, refer to the plugin’s documentation for troubleshooting.

Q: How do I check the sync status?

A: The sync status can be checked from the Universell menu in the WordPress dashboard. After syncing, you will see the total number of products, customers, and orders successfully synced.

Q: Can I use this plugin with multiple WordPress sites?

A: Yes, you can use the plugin on multiple WordPress sites, but each site must be connected individually to your Universell account with its own set of credentials.

Q: What happens if I disconnect the plugin from Universell?

A: If you disconnect the plugin from Universell, the synchronization will stop, and data will no longer be synced between your WordPress site and Universell. You can reconnect at any time by entering your credentials again.

Q: Will the plugin work with WooCommerce?

A: Yes, the plugin is compatible with WooCommerce and will sync product, customer, and order data from Universell to your WooCommerce store.

Q: Is there any support for troubleshooting or issues?

A: Yes, you can access the plugin’s documentation for troubleshooting tips or reach out to the plugin support team for help with any issues you encounter.
